verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email platform, so internal comments and @mentions on a message are a fair axis to judge. The evidence pack documents no comment or @mention feature beside messages or threads. Cc'ing a human, draft review and labels are related features, not internal side-thread discussion, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
